title: Mobility Equipment Patient Agreement Clause — Title Transfer at the Rental Cap
content:
# Title Transfer at the Rental Cap — Mobility Equipment

**Clause.** Title to a rented Mobility Equipment chair passes once the paid months of the current rental period reach the coverage class's capped rental months; the ownership date is the day after the last day of the final paid month. A month beyond the cap is denied with the denial reason cap reached and never charged to the patient. Months under an earlier coverage or rental period do not count. An owned chair is never picked up.

## The paid months that count

The paid months counted are the paid rental months of the chair under the coverage the wheelchair record names, whose first day of service is on or after the rental period start date, up to the day of handling, less every paid month the payer has since taken back.

## Points of judgement

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| Do months paid under a previous coverage count toward the cap? | No. |
| Do months of an earlier rental period count? | No. |
| A month is billed after the cap is reached | It is denied as cap reached and never charged to the patient. |
| Is an owned chair collected? | No; an owned chair is never picked up. |

## Hypothetical illustration

Under a coverage class whose capped rental months are 13 (a hypothetical figure), a chair whose rental months begin on the 15th has its 13th paid month running from 15 January; the last day of that month is 14 February, so the ownership date is 15 February. A 14th month billed for the chair is denied as cap reached.
